# O-Form on GitHub

This repository hosts **O-Form**, a clone of Blender 5.2.3 LTS for OSAS (Open Source Architecture Suit).

**Product documentation starts here:** [../README.md](../README.md)  
**Guides:** [../docs/README.md](../docs/README.md)

This is an independent HolagundiWorks repository. It is **not** the Blender Foundation GitHub mirror and is **not** affiliated with the Blender Foundation.

Source and issues: https://github.com/HolagundiWorks/o-form
